arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Nevada officials state tribal jurisdiction over state agents creates inconsistency.
Tribal members state the court holds power over personal-capacity damages.
Nevada officials note non-federal claims lose standing without federal claims.
Tribal members note the wardens sought tribal court approval twice.
